name: tasksync
description: TaskSync — AI Daily Sync: automated EOD reporting to Slack and Google Sheets

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @tasksync/web && npm run build --workspace @tasksync/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @tasksync/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @tasksync/server
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --only hosting:teamdailysync
